title: Yun Bhi Karte Hai
body:
yun bhi karte hai juda quran ko tafseer se
jis tarha shabbir bichda zainab e dilgeer se
<<DIVIDER>>
jao behna ab tumhari jang hoti hai shuru
be-kafan bhai ye bola be-rida hamsheer se
yun bhi karte hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
khaak par likhti gayi hai karbala ki daastan
jo lahoo ki dhaar nikli gardane shabbir se
yun bhi karte hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
padh ke khat sughra ka maula ro diye ke kya kahun
mustufa ki khoon mein doobi hui tasveer se
yun bhi karte hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
nanhi si chadar na lut'ti to tujhe deti kafan
yun sakina keh rahi thi laasha e baysheer se
yun bhi karte hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
saani e zehra ne logon aap hoke be-rida
deen par saaya kiya hai chadar e tatheer se
yun bhi karte hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
jafari khaayam namaz o roza o haj o zakat
aaj bhi hai murtuza ke khoon ki taseer se
yun bhi karte hai...
